notes: Ali's CTA reads 'Comment "WANT" to / if you NEED one' (stray 'to'). Kept verbatim until Ali says to fix it. The team in the hook caption must match the team in the clip.
rules: Normal edit: only the hook changes (sometimes the rehook). Body, end clip, caption style and song placement come from the template.

Hook longer or shorter than the template: the tool ripples the timeline. Body and CTA move, the hook caption stretches, the song starts earlier (music box, handoff fixed) or runs longer (no end sound).
Store-claim hooks (RUN to <STORE>, <BRAND> x <STORE>, '<STORE> just collabed') pair with the reveal CTA (JK / Just JOKING / Je rigole). Every other hook pairs with the plain CTA.
Use the store the hook clip actually shows (TARGET / WALMART / COSTCO / LECLERC / CARREFOUR).
workflow: Two structures, picked by the hook clip: a FULL clip (store gasp -> grab -> door projection, final-clips/full-videos or a full replication) uses 'full-video'; a short hook clip uses 'gift-hook' (hook + the full Costco-pallet-to-door clip). Song is chosen separately and swapped in. Door Beam has no raw end sound: one song under the whole video. Its start is synced to the hook, so a longer hook extends the song at the END, never the beginning (Ali, 2026-10-08).
song_note: Song is swapped from music/library.json. Open question for Ali: in all 4 of his Free Bird edits the song ENDS at 4:59.2 and the start moves (4:44-4:48), i.e. he extended Free Bird at the beginning. Until he answers, every song follows his stated rule (start fixed, extend the end).
exclude: V1 (montage that reuses the hook clip on a second layer) and Timeline 03 (no song) are not templates.
